items.quote: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt

items.quote: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I am the LORD
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses declaring himself as the LORD

items.quote: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to speak to Pharaoh of Egypt
